register.notes: e-RA register covers only WEEE/batteries — packaging compliance runs through Valorlux membership (Point Vert / Green Dot) in practice. No separate state packaging producer register.

pro.ecoModulation: Point Vert 2026 tariffs differentiate plastics heavily: PET clear bottles 0.2498, HDPE rigid 0.3058, PP rigid 0.4279, PS 0.4372, PE films 0.7120, other non-recoverable 1.4830 €/kg; steel (0.0396) dearer than aluminium (0.0151).

notes: Rates from the official Valorlux 'Tarifs Point Vert 2026 (déclaration détaillée)' PDF (fetched and parsed 2026-08-16, €/kg excl. VAT, household): glass (PV01) 0.0203, paper/cardboard >85% (PV02) 0.0389, beverage cartons (PV03) 0.2810 ('composite'), steel (PV04) 0.0396 (shown as 'metal'; aluminium PV05 0.0151), plastics PV06–PV15 range 0.2094 (EPS) – 1.4830 ('plastic' shows HDPE rigid PV10 0.3058). Household wood not a separate row (cork PV14b 0.2238); non-household packaging has flat rates PV16–PV19 (paper/wood 0.0145, plastic/metal 0.0395 €/kg).
